# Vibe Check: Golden Hour

> Vibe Check is a private one-minute evening mood journal for recording real days and noticing personal patterns over time.

## Official product information

- [Product overview](/product.md)
- [Privacy policy](/privacy)
- [Terms of use](/terms)
- [Support](/support)

## Key facts

- The core journal records mood, energy, sleep, feelings, activities, and optional reflections.
- Pattern views summarize a user's own saved history.
- Tarot, astrology, numerology, and AI material are optional reflection and entertainment tools, not medical advice or factual prediction.
- Specialist chart values are user-provided or deterministically calculated where supported. Vibe Check does not use AI to invent precise chart values.
- Users can export their history and permanently delete their account in the app.
- Vibe Check does not sell personal data or use it for advertising.
